name: pr-self-employment-tax
description: Work out and file federal self-employment tax for a bona fide resident of Puerto Rico for tax year 2026. Explains why Puerto Rico source income excluded from federal income tax under section 933 still carries self-employment tax, when Form 1040-SS is filed instead of Form 1040 with Schedule SE, the USD 400 net earnings test, how wages on Form 499R-2/W-2PR reduce the social security base, the Additional Medicare Tax lines on the 2026 Form 1040-SS, the additional child tax credit in Part II (limited by social security and Medicare taxes paid, not by earned income), estimated tax when self-employment tax will be USD 1,000 or more, and the 15 April 2027 due date with the Form 4868 extension that does not extend payment. The 2026 self-employment rates, wage base and Schedule SE steps are linked to us-schedule-c-and-se-computation.
